title: store-assembly: consolidate its requirements under the cap, then answer its provider notices
prior_work: First, consolidate build/requirements/store-assembly.md (95700 bytes) under the requirements cap (70000): move non-requirement text (status history, rulings, cross-references, commentary) to docs/requirements-notes/store-assembly.md, which this job owns, and keep every **R<n>** and **F<n>** line and its mark verbatim; add a test under this module's tests that asserts the set of requirement ids and unmet marks in build/requirements/store-assembly.md is unchanged by the move (compare against the ids at the start commit). Then do the provider-notice work this START lists: for each notice, decide from your own requirements what this module must do, adapt or confirm, and add a test of your own for the change, failing with it reverted where code changes. Only if consolidation cannot get the file under the cap, stop and report to BOB with a split proposal (new module ids, build/modules.json rows, build/layers.md). Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: For BOB. The work is pushed (feec7b56). Suite 467/474, and the 2 failures are not store-assembly's. (1) The fix your START asks for is already on tranche, so no code changed: assemble.mjs:229-230 hands ai-accounts the store's own ai-catalogue through credentials, and ask.mjs admitOn calls ai-runs.partAdmitted(part, entry) and reads {admitted, untested} as ai-runs declares it. New tests in plane-green.test.mjs: a member's own T53 account set through the store's door (aiownadd, then aiaccountswitch and aisend) answers ok and serves the ask; an ask part is admitted on that account's entry through partAdmitted, and on the entry's own Gate 1 verdict it is admitted with no label. Revert checks run by hand: with the catalogue not handed, both fail; with admitOn reading .ok, or calling partAdmitted(part) with no entry, the second fails. Plane's t48 R55 and t50 R63 can now be rewritten onto this path: disclosure recorded, then aiownadd, aiaccountswitch on, aisend. (2) Notice case-tensions:262 confirmed with no code change (notice-case-tensions-262.test.mjs; needs --exempt-revert). PR 262 changes only how case-tensions spells the re-authored attribution body. It holds 199 ids and build/modules.json holds 200, since reader-contract was added (order-build.mjs --check exits 1). The file is member-roster's generated output, not mine. To unblock: run node bio-plane/src/member-roster/order-build.mjs on tranche, then restart this job or have it run job complete.
